Cases were created by the admin HL7 send endpoint on mayo-mayo, not a live Epic SIU feed; the admin path is the same processTenantMessage call as the integration endpoint.

Changeset 227 ran at boot against an empty tenant; its UPDATE was validated by running the statement by hand on rows set non-compliant, not against production compliance history.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: On mayo-mayo, SIU-staged D&C-alone and D&C plus exam-under-anesthesia cases both returned the Doxycycline PO Not Given Preoperatively alert at app launch and wrote rule_fired_results rows.
Negative: D&C plus hysterectomy and D&C plus an unmapped procedure returned no alert, with not-fired explanations naming p-hysterectomy-open and the procedure that mapped to nothing.
Red check: The pre-fix rule class was compiled and swapped into the running container, the same D&C plus hysterectomy and unmapped cases then fired the alert, and the shipped class was restored with a matching checksum.

Automation: Unit tests already cover every row of the ticket table, so the proposed additions are a small supplemental qa-suite family exercising the SIU-to-app-launch wiring on the Mayo tenant.
